explanation: Execution plans reveal scans, joins, sorts, and selectivity issues. Indexes should be chosen from measured access patterns because unnecessary indexes add write and storage cost. It preserves the relevant runtime or architectural guarantee while avoiding unnecessary complexity.

question: A public API accepts an object containing many fields but only two are needed. Why can a dedicated request DTO be preferable Which option best addresses the root cause rather than merely masking the symptom when the service is running in multiple regions??
options: It makes the contract explicit and reduces accidental coupling to internal models
It guarantees faster network transport in all cases
It removes the need for validation
explanation: Dedicated DTOs define stable external contracts and prevent internal entity changes from leaking into APIs. Validation and mapping can also be explicit. The selected approach targets the underlying mechanism and keeps operational behavior predictable.
